use_cases: Selecting user avatars during account creation or profile setup
Picking avatars for comment sections or chat applications
Customizing user identity in messaging or collaboration tools
Choosing display avatars in social media or community platforms
Assigning avatars for multi-user systems or admin panels
ai_summary: An interactive avatar picker component with animated transitions and search functionality. Features a grid of colorful avatar options with color-coded selection rings, smooth hover effects, and motion-based animations. Includes filter input and displays the currently selected avatar with a prominent preview. Built as a composite component using Card, Button, and Input primitives from the kokonutui design system.
